title: Exploring Large Language Models for Hate Speech Detection in Rioplatense Spanish

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance (Precision, Recall, F1-score) in detecting hate speech between texts containing specific regionalisms/slang (Rioplatense Spanish) and those without, to measure dialectal sensitivity.
Evaluating multi-label hate speech detection performance using few-shot Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting on tweets specifically targeting women and the feminist movement.
